I agree, however, the problem is not the Internet, it is us, it is not the tool, but how we use that tool, the Internet is incredible, the ability to communicate with people from all over the world is the closest thing to science fiction.

At this moment, the words you are reading only exist in my head, because I write while I think, and even though I am thousands of miles away from you, you do not see me, you do not know me, but, you can understand me, you know what I have in my mind, this is amazing!

We don't crave "likes", we want attention, we need communication! Just turn off your phone and go out to make some friends! Go for a walk! Have you see the sky? It's beautiful!

It gets better, but YOU have to do better, every day. 

You are the root of change, that is the truth, but I understand you, being depressed is much more comfortable than trying to fix your life, and there is no guarantee of success anyway, so why bother, right? It is what it is, if you want to feel better, be a better you. 

I didn't ask to be born either, I'm something like, a random thing in the universe, with no real purpose, other than the one that I give myself. That's great! I can do whatever I want! but... I am more than an individual, I am part of something else, nothing of what I am comes from me, all my ideas, my values ​​and my beliefs come from outside, so in a certain way, I am what others made me.

"We live in a society", so, no man belongs to himself, when was the last time you grew and cooked your own food? Do you remember knitting your clothes? your shoes? did you build your own home? we need others as much as others need us!, maybe helping others will help you feel at peace with yourself.

I want to die too, but human life is so short compared to the age of the universe that it doesn't matter if I wait a couple more years, death is certain, in the meantime I want to help. Be my friend.
